'''2012 US Nationals Day 2 Aaron Nelson LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Username:''' Airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
